0022600212.text: The 76ers (9-2, 1st in the Atlantic and East) host the Boston Celtics (8-2, 2nd in the Atlantic and East, 0.5 games back) in Philadelphia's 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with the 76ers on a one-game win streak and the Celtics on three straight wins. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back, sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting 2-2 in 2025-26 and the 76ers winning their 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, with the 76ers' 109-100 win in Boston on May 2, 2026 the most recent meeting.
